goal: Avoid node crashes and shutdown hangs on low-disk systems by deferring background chainstate compaction
Keep compaction status logged by default and skip periodic compaction for in-memory databases
agreement: Support after addressing compaction handling and log phrasing (optout21, stickies-v)
Unaddressed objection: warns on deferred compaction though low-disk users cannot act on it (andrewtoth)
Suggests dropping the release note for this change (andrewtoth)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes a stability regression causing node crashes or hung shutdowns on tight disks
Compaction temporarily doubles database disk usage, risking disk exhaustion on low-margin nodes
